name: Splice
tagline: Splice is a leading platform for music producers offering a vast royalty-free sample library, plugin subscriptions, and AI-powered creation tools. Its CoSo AI app generates unique loops and beats from sample collections, while its sample recommendation AI surfaces relevant sounds.
